scope: Matched serial CPU/x64 perfect-gas regression and official PyPI comparison. No package/dependency patches. Source-calibrated model equations differ from PyPI: temperatures/pressures and each model's own identities are checked, not equality of enthalpy offsets or heat capacities. Complete old/new state payloads and common-13 outputs are both reported. Component consumers are bounded ideal-gas surrogates, not full ThermOpt application acceptance.

method.first_call: Recorded separately; excluded from warmed results.
method.changing_python_values: Fresh unique scalar inputs, includes compilation; separate from warmed runtime.
method.legacy_policies: PyPI does not expose mask/clip; those valid-state counterpart labels use its untouched default call. Synthetic status output in the legacy common-plus-status consumer is a zero array for this all-valid fixture, not a source policy.
method.array_pressure_cases: Natural compiled HP consumers close over scalar pressure; additional matched-array-pressure consumers pass full-shape pressure arrays to all versions. Original natural cases remain unchanged.
method.all_properties_exports: The complete public to_dict() export is materialized and synchronized, including deferred masks. PyPI exports its 38-field schema with unavailable placeholders; current exports its 22 enabled physical fields. Exact field/buffer counts are reported. Existing-state eager export excludes state evaluation and is not additive with fused compiled calls.

process_affinity.topology_label: Logical CPU indices only; performance/efficiency core class is not inferred.
process_affinity.scope: This worker process only; parent/user applications are unchanged.

source_hash_method: Sorted jaxprop/**/*.py relative POSIX path, NUL, exact bytes, NUL; SHA256.
